questions.prompt: Why did Bossy tell Honky to use a small voice?
questions.evidenceText: Use a small voice when friends are close.

questions.prompt: How did Honky's big voice help during the storm?
choices: It helped every Dino Pal hear him.
questions.answer: It helped every Dino Pal hear him.
questions.evidenceText: "This way to the safe cave!" Honky called. His big voice helped every Dino Pal hear him.

questions.prompt: What did Honky learn about his voice?
choices: A soft voice works best during a storm.
A small voice for talking and a big voice when needed.
A big voice works best when one friend is close.
questions.answer: A small voice for talking and a big voice when needed.
questions.evidenceText: A small voice for talking. A big voice when we need it.
